_note: Hosts that content (notes, practice, landing, compare, site.json) may link to over https. Anything else fails the build (safeurl.py). Generated 2026-11-11 from the https hosts present in content/, landing/, data/ and site.json, plus the site's own domains and the Polar checkout hosts. To allow a new host, add it here in a reviewed change. path_exact limits a host to those exact paths (ankiweb.net hosts user content). buy.polar.sh is accepted only in catalog checkout_url fields, never in markdown or other fields; polar.sh is not allowed.
